mostWorthwhile.text: The transubstantiation explanation distinguished unchanged taste from evidence that the claimed change occurred, making the limits of observation clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial taste distinction felt incomplete until the later explanation supplied the positive claim.

surprise.text: The comparison showed that physical materials have different roles in the two rites, rather than simply serving the same purpose.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the later choices were the only offered combinations rather than discoveries of compatibility.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see more comparisons that clarify theological claims while distinguishing them from proofs.
